title: SAGE distributed virtual work-cell exhibit

exhibit.camera_path: close floor-level rail move rising to an overview
exhibit.purpose: Show many independent software workers exploring generic stock shapes at the same time. A worker is a virtual work cell, not a physical robot.

what_is_shown: Forty independent virtual cells with seed-bound stock dimensions and public shape classes
Staggered progress so the grid reads as concurrent software exploration
A six-second NVIDIA Isaac Sim render with a credited CC BY 4.0 machine-shop backdrop
what_is_not_shown: Private model weights, training recipes, or raw episode corpora
Guaranteed transfer of simulated results to a specific machine
